summary: INOVIO PHARMACEUTICALS filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered public offering of 21,052,632 common shares with warrants to purchase up to 42,105,264 shares, at a combined price of $0.95 per unit. The last sale was $1.03 on July 28, 2026, implying a modest discount. Sole manager is Piper Sandler. The offering is an ordinary capital raise, not a special situation. Key watch item: warrant exercise overhang from the 5-year, $1.10 strike warrants.
